title: SKILL.md Frontmatter Schema
description: JSON Schema for validating SKILL.md YAML frontmatter in the DO App Platform Skills repository

description.description: Brief description of what the skill does and when to use it

related_skills.description: List of skill names this skill commonly works with

deprecated_message.description: Message explaining deprecation and migration path (required if deprecated is true)

sunset_date.description: Date when deprecated skill will be removed (ISO 8601 format)

metadata.description: Optional metadata consumed by skill discovery tools (e.g. the `skills` CLI). Unknown keys are permitted so upstream tooling can evolve without schema churn.

internal.description: If true, this SKILL.md is treated as a router/wrapper and is hidden from default `skills add --list` output. Nested skills under `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` are then discovered instead. See https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills discovery rules.
